At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilizing the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey.

You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform with Startup and Emerging Enterprise customers. You will also help ensure customer success by helping our most complex customers maximize the value they get out of our platform and their return on investment.
This is a hybrid technical and commercial role.

It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases by leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestrating other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon.

It is technical in the sense that you will serve as the post-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate at all levels within an organization. You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization.

Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritized customers
Lead the post-technical-win account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
Be the accountable technical leader for specific use cases and customers across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, go-live, and healthy consumption of the workloads the customer has chosen to run on Databricks
Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, often spanning multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
Leverage Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services, and Support resources, and escalate to subject matter experts when work falls beyond your scope or expertise
Create, own, and execute a point of view on how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
Partner with Databricks Product and Engineering teams on new product innovations, private previews, and upgrades
Develop an execution plan spanning all customer-facing technical roles and teams across the following work streams:
Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production
Enablement / user growth plan
Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)
Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning & optimization)
Executive and operational governance
Provide internal and external updates to your Technical GM — KPI reporting on usage and customer health, covering investment status, key risks, product adoption, and use case progression

5+ years of experience accountable for technical project / program delivery in Data and AI, with the ability to contribute to technical debate and design choices alongside customers
Programming experience in Python, SQL or Scala
Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role
Understanding of solution architecture for distributed data systems
Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverable
Technical program or project management, including accountability for accounts, stakeholders, and resources
Experience resolving complex, high-stakes escalations with senior customer executives
Experience conducting open-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis, and managing delivery of complex programs/projects
Track record of overachievement against quota, goals, or similar objective targets
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Can travel up to 30% when needed

Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles.

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range.

The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page here .

Req ID: FEQ227R81
Location : Osaka, Japan
As a Pre‑sales Solutions Architect (Analytics, AI, Big Data, Public Cloud) – Kansai Region, your mission will be to drive successful technical evaluations and solution designs for some of our focus customers in the Kansai region (Osaka/Kyoto) for Databricks Japan.

You are passionate about data and AI, love getting hands‑on with technology, and enjoy communicating its value to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Partnering closely with Account Executives, you will lead the technical discovery, architecture design, and proof‑of‑concept phases, and act as a trusted advisor to our customers on their data and AI strategy.

You will help customers realize tangible, data‑driven outcomes on the Databricks Lakehouse Platform by guiding data and AI teams to design, build, and operationalize solutions within their enterprise ecosystem. You will also be a key technical voice back into our product and field teams, championing customer needs from the Kansai market.

You will report to the Manager of Field Engineering.

You will be a Big Data Analytics expert on aspects of architecture and design
Lead your prospects through evaluating and adopting Databricks
Support your customers by authoring reference architectures, how-tos, and demo applications
Integrate Databricks with 3rd-party applications to support customer architectures
Engage with the technical community by leading workshops, seminars and meet-ups
Together with your Account Executive, you will form successful relationships with clients throughout your assigned territory to provide technical and business value

Pre-sales or post-sales experience working with external clients across a variety of industry markets
Understanding of customer-facing pre-sales or consulting role with a core strength in either Data Engineering or Data Science advantageous
Experience demonstrating technical concepts, including presenting and whiteboarding
Experience designing and implementing architectures within public clouds (AWS, Azure or GCP)
Experience with Big Data technologies, including Apache Spark™, AI, Data Science, Data Engineering, Hadoop, Cassandra, and others.
Fluent coding experience in Python or Scala implementing Apache Spark™, Java and R is also desirable
Experience working with Enterprise Accounts
Written and verbal fluency in Japanese

As a Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA), you will guide customers in building big data solutions on Databricks that span a large variety of use cases. These are customer-facing roles, working with and supporting the Solution Architects, requiring hands-on production experience with cloud infrastructure and big data technologies.

SSAs help customers through the design and successful implementation of essential workloads while aligning their technical roadmap for expanding the usage of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.

As a deep go-to-expert reporting to the Specialist Field Engineering Manager, you will continue to strengthen your technical skills through mentorship, learning, and internal training programs to continuously consolidate the skills in your area of speciality.

Provide technical leadership to guide strategic customers to successful implementations on big data projects, ranging from architectural and security design to development and deployment best practices including automation
Architect production-level workloads, including end-to-end pipeline load performance testing and optimisation
Provide technical expertise in cloud infrastructure and security relating to our Databricks Intelligence Platform
Assist Solution Architects with more advanced aspects of the technical sale including custom proof of concept content, workload sizing, and custom architectures
Improve community adoption (through tutorials, training, hackathons, conference presentations)
Contribute to the Databricks Community and act as a technical SME.

Pre-sales or post-sales experience working with external clients across a variety of industry markets
Experience as a Data Platform engineer designing, setting up, and maintaining production-grade big data systems (Spark)
Experience designing cloud infrastructure and services, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, applying best practices in cloud security and networking, including:
Designing, deploying, and maintaining cloud networks and connectivity (VPC/VNet design, routing, segmentation, private connectivity).
Architect production cloud networks for data and AI workloads, including segmentation and routing, data exfiltration prevention, and performance/reliability
Identity & Access Management (e.g. role-based access control, using the principle of least privilege, integration with IdPs, etc)
Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure automation (e.g. Terraform or cloud-specific resource management tools like ARM, CloudFormation, etc).
Experience supporting customers in designing and implementing a security lakehouse/security data platform on Databricks to augment SIEM, enable security analytics and threat hunting, and build advanced detections.
Ability to design and extend highly performant, scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud-based big data solutions
Deep knowledge of development tools and best practices for engineers including CI/CD, unit and integration testing, plus automation and orchestration
Production programming experience in one or more of the following languages - Python, Scala, SQL, or R
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent work experience
The role located in Singapore covers the Asean and Greater China Regions, which requires travel up to 30% when needed.

Location: Melbourne
At Databricks, our core principles are at the heart of everything we do; creating a culture of proactiveness and a customer-centric mindset guides us to create a unified platform that makes data science and analytics accessible to everyone. We aim to inspire our customers to make informed decisions that push their business forward.

We provide a user-friendly and intuitive platform that makes it easy to turn insights into action and fosters a culture of creativity, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

You will be an essential part of this mission, using your technical expertise to demonstrate how our Data Intelligence Platform can help customers solve their complex data challenges.

You'll work with a collaborative, customer-focused team that values innovation and creativity, using your skills to create customized solutions to help our customers achieve their goals and guide their businesses forward. Join us in our quest to change how people work with data and make a better world! This is a hybrid role based in Melbourne.

Develop customer engagement strategies in partnership with Account Executive(s) in your designated territory.
Coach junior Solutions Architects and teams on use case prioritization and building technical champions.
You will influence stakeholders at all levels through complex engagements with the wider cloud ecosystem and 3rd party applications, ensuring they are excited by the Databricks vision and solution strategy.
Be a 'champion’ for both customers and colleagues, operating as an expert solution architect and trusted advisor for significant data analytics architecture, design, and adoption of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
Contribute to Databricks' technical community engagement by developing customer-facing collateral and leading workshops, seminars, and meet-ups.
Opportunity to continue your development in one of four tracks - technical specialization, industry vertical thought leadership, strategic customer vision, and people management.

Know how to engage in complex customer interactions and sales lifecycle in a technical pre-sales capacity.
Ability to influence decision-makers and C-level executives by developing relationships and orchestrating teams to achieve long-term customer success.
Prior experience with coding in a core programming language (i.e., Python, Java, Scala) and willingness to learn a base level of Spark.
Hands-on expertise with complex proofs-of-concept and public cloud platform(s).
Know how to provide technical solutions for specialized customer needs and navigate a competitive landscape.

We are looking for a passionate technologist to join our Pre-Sales organization and help ensure our growth is grounded in strong technical alignment between MongoDB, our partners, and the needs of our customers.
MongoDB Solutions Architects help customers and partners design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. On the Partners team, this role goes beyond core solution design and includes driving technical strategy with hyperscalers, GSIs, ISVs, and ecosystem partners; shaping joint solutions; and creating repeatable field assets that accelerate adoption.
You will work closely with sales, partner, and technical stakeholders to solve business problems with MongoDB, influence complex opportunities, and help build partner-led growth in India and across the region.
This role will be based remotely in Bengaluru.

Design scalable, secure, and high-performing application, data, and AI architectures using MongoDB Atlas for customer and partner-led solutions
Act as a trusted technical advisor to partners, sellers, and customers by guiding architecture reviews, modernization strategies, and deployment decisions across cloud and hybrid environments
Work on complex partner and ecosystem opportunities that require deep technical discovery, solution mapping, demos, proofs of value, sizing, and technical documentation
Build and refine joint partner offerings, integration patterns, quick starts, workshops, demos and reference architectures with hyperscalers, ISVs, and strategic ecosystem partners
Create reusable field assets such as demos, presentations, sample architectures, workshops, and technical guidance that help sellers and partners scale MongoDB adoption.
Advise on modern AI application patterns including RAG, vector search, agentic workflows, and integration approaches across partner ecosystems
Support field and partner teams with implementation guidance, technical objections, and practical workarounds where product capabilities, frameworks, or documentation are still evolving
Collaborate with product, engineering, and partner teams to relay field feedback, influence roadmap conversations, and improve the quality of MongoDB integrations and partner experiences
Partner with account teams on territory and account planning, opportunity qualification, pipeline generation, and technical win strategy
Represent MongoDB externally through customer workshops, partner sessions, industry events, and thought leadership content
Mentor peers and help raise the bar for the broader Solutions Consulting organization through knowledge sharing and repeatable best practices
As an ideal candidate, you will have
12+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, including significant pre-sales, consulting, partner, or solutions architecture experience in enterprise software
Strong experience navigating complex sales cycles and aligning technical and business stakeholders across customers, partners, and internal teams
Hands-on experience with modern application development, data platforms, or cloud-native systems, including at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, JavaScript, Java, C#, or SQL
Experience designing distributed systems in cloud and hybrid environments with an understanding of scalability, resilience, and security considerations
The ability to translate technical architecture into business value for executives, architects, developers, and partner stakeholders
Experience working with one or more of the following: hyperscaler partnerships, ISV integrations, AI/ML applications, data engineering, platform modernization, or developer platforms
A demonstrated ability to create technical assets, lead workshops, and enable broader field teams with reusable content and repeatable patterns
Strong presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority
Familiarity with modern sales methodologies and strong collaboration with sales leadership
The ability to travel up to 25%
You may also have
Experience with database programming and data models
Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
Experience in SRE practices
Proven ability to up-level the broader organization - for example by sharing best practices or creating reusable assets
A MongoDB Certification or a Cloud Provider Certification
Experience with MongoDB Atlas and adjacent services such as Search, Vector Search, Stream Processing, Data Lake, and related application modernization patterns
Experience with partner technologies and ecosystems such as AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka, or framework-level integrations used in modern AI applications
A track record of public speaking, publishing technical content, or representing a company in external technical forums
What you will learn
MongoDB Product Suite Mastery
Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly

Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes

Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space

Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding
Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling

Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries
Why this role matters
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys blending solution architecture, partner strategy, technical sales, and emerging technology. The strongest candidates will be comfortable operating at the intersection of customer outcomes, partner ecosystems, field enablement, and product innovation.
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software.

MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI.

Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.

MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform.

Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations.

You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin or Cork for our hybrid working model.

Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.
If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.
Information Systems at Lambda is responsible for building and scaling the internal systems that power our business. We partner across the company—Finance, GTM, Engineering, and People—to implement tools, automate workflows, and ensure data flows securely and accurately. Our scope includes enterprise applications, integrations, data platform and analytics, compliance automation, and all things IT.

We are seeking an experienced Business Systems Architect to lead and innovate across our enterprise systems landscape. This role will be pivotal in driving operational excellence through the design, implementation, and optimization of scalable business processes and systems integrations.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to create seamless workflows across financial systems, supply chain, and customer-facing platforms while leveraging process automation tools and middleware solutions.
Your responsibilities will include architecting end-to-end solutions, managing complex system integrations, running enterprise system enhancements. This role requires excellent business acumen and deep technical expertise, and a proactive approach to solving business challenges.

Solution Design & Implementation : Architect and deploy advanced workflows, scripts, configurations, and modules in enterprise platforms like NetSuite, Coupa, Stripe, and Chargebee.
Integration & Automation: Manage integrations and optimize iPaaS tools (e.g., Workato, Mulesoft) to ensure seamless data flow, interoperability, and automated processes across platforms.
Compliance & Optimization: Ensure SOX compliance through robust internal controls, system audits, and governance while driving continuous system improvements.
Support & Analytics: Troubleshoot complex issues, and deliver actionable insights through advanced reporting and dashboards to support decision-making.

8+ years of experience in business systems architecture or administration, including hands-on implementation of enterprise systems.
Strong understanding of Finance technology stacks, including NetSuite, Coupa, Supply Chain, Asset Management, Billing systems and related business applications
Certifications in relevant platforms (e.g., NetSuite Administrator, iPaaS) strongly preferred.

Proficiency in languages like JavaScript/SQL/ HTML/CSS/Python.
Strong experience with middleware and low/no-code platforms (e.g., Workato, n8n, Mulesoft, Alteryx) for system integrations & workflow automations.
Demonstrated success in deploying process automation tools to streamline operations and increase efficiency.
Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Git, Jenkins) in the context of NetSuite development.
Proficiency in managing API integrations between NetSuite and external systems using REST, SOAP, and other protocols.
Background in Agile/Scrum project management methodologies.
Experience working in multi-subsidiary, multi-currency environments.
Strong knowledge of ITGCs (IT General Controls) and SOX compliance.

Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate across all levels of leadership from technical staff to senior executives.
Proven ability to present complex technical solutions in a clear and compelling manner
AI Automation & Development
Hands-on experience leveraging AI and machine learning tools to design, build, and deploy intelligent automation solutions that enhance business processes.
Proficiency with AI-powered platforms and frameworks (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, or similar) to develop custom workflows, copilots, and agentic solutions.
Proven ability to identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into scalable AI-driven implementations across finance and enterprise systems.

How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

アイデンティティセキュリティ基盤「Josys」について
Josysは、企業内のあらゆる認証情報（アイデンティティ）を統合的に管理・防御する、AI駆動のアイデンティティセキュリティ基盤です。従業員・業務委託先のアカウントに加え、AIエージェントやサービスアカウントなど、人・AI・システムを横断して増加する認証情報を一元的に可視化し、守ります。
ダークウェブ起点の認証情報漏洩・感染端末の検知、AIエージェントの自動発見と管理、ポリシーにもとづくAIの自律型セキュリティ対応を中核に、SaaS統合管理で培ったアクセスガバナンスやライセンス最適化の機能を統合。権限管理やリスク対応を自動化し、セキュリティ人材不足のなかでも運用負荷を抑えながら、組織全体のアイデンティティを守ります。
Josysは、"すべてのアイデンティティ、すべてのアプリケーションを、AIで守る"ことを通じて、日本企業が安心して事業活動を行える環境づくりを推進してまいります。
解決する課題
急速に利用が拡大するSaaS・AIアプリにより、世界中のコーポレート部門は複雑な管理業務を求められる状況にあります。また、昨今のサイバーセキュリティインシデントでは、漏洩したIDを用いた攻撃がスタンダードとなっており、エンタープライズを中心により高いレベルでの対策が急務となっています。
一方で、求められる速度に管理が追いつかず、管理の抜け・更新漏れ・管理主体の分散など、企業のITガバナンスは危機的な状況にあります。これはコロナ禍を経てSaaS利用が増大した背景があり、日本だけでなくグローバルで同時多発的に発生している新しい課題であり、企業規模に関わらず多くの企業が抱えている経営リスクです。
そこで求められるのは、AIによってアイデンティティ・SaaS・デバイスの情報を統合的に管理し、リスクを最小化しながら運用を効率化することです。ジョーシスはAI Drivenなマネジメントプラットフォームを通じて、現場のオペレーションまで一貫して支援し、企業のアイデンティティ管理におけるガバナンス向上とセキュリティリスクの最小化に寄与します。
日本発グローバル企業への挑戦
海外発SaaSを国内で使う機会は多いものの、グローバルで使われる日本発SaaSはほとんどないのが実情です。それだけ "グローバルプロダクト" を事業として成功させることの難易度は高いとも言えます。JOSYSはそんな現状を打ち破り、日本をマザーマーケットとしながら世界でも使われるサービスを提供していくチャレンジの真っ只中にいます。この難易度の高い課題を、優秀なグローバルの同僚と共に、自分自身の手で創り上げていく熱い想いのある方を募集しています。
概要
Josysは「Simplify IT, Empower communities」をミッションに、企業のIT運用そのものを再定義するグローバルSaaS / AIソリューションを提供しています。 現在、エンタープライズ企業からの引き合いが急速に拡大しており、本ポジションは、お客様の「IT運用の変革」を最前線で支援し、Josysの提供価値を最大化させるAccount Consultantです。
導入支援（Solution Consulting）を通じて強固な信頼基盤を築いた後、お客様の潜在的な課題に対し、SaaS・AI・BPOを組み合わせた統合的なソリューションを能動的に提案します。「顧客の成功＝Josysの利用拡大（Expansion）」と捉え、アップセル・クロスセルを通じてお客様のITインフラを全方位で支えるパートナーとしての活躍を期待しています。
業務内容
エンタープライズ顧客の認証・セキュリティ構造の要件定義と設計
導入初期段階において、お客様の既存のID（アイデンティティ）基盤、セキュリティポリシー、ネットワーク環境をヒアリングし、Josysを中核とした最適な統合管理モデルを設計します。
複雑なアイデンティティ環境のハックと移行ロードマップ策定
従業員・業務委託先だけでなく、AIエージェントやサービスアカウントなど、混在する複雑な権限情報を構造化し、ガバナンスを効かせるための移行プロセスを定義します。
技術的課題の解決とプロダクトへのフィードバック
導入フェーズにおける難易度の高い技術的制約やAPI連携等の課題に対し、自ら技術的な解決策（ソリューション）を提示します。また、現場で得たインフラ・セキュリティニーズを開発チームへフィードバックし、基盤の進化を共創します。
アーキテクチャの標準化・型化
業界別や企業規模別の成功パターンを「リファレンスアーキテクチャ（標準設計モデル）」として言語化・Playbook化し、組織全体の導入スケーラビリティを向上させます。
求める経験
【専門知識は不要です】 現時点でセキュリティ、インフラ、ID管理の知識は一切問いません。入社後に1からキャッチアップできる体制が整っています。「複雑な物事を整理することが好き」「顧客の課題解決に深く伴走したい」という意欲を重視した採用を行っています。

誠実な対話と信頼構築（Accountability & Transparency / Winning as a team）：目先の数字だけでなく、透明性のある対話を通じて長期的な信頼を築き、チームの成果を最大化できる方
不確実性を楽しむ柔軟性（Adaptability & Builders Mindset）：決まった提案書をなぞるのではなく、顧客ごとに最適なソリューションを自ら考え、提案の型を創り出せる方
ハンズオンでの実践と成長（Hands-on Execution）：戦略的な提案から、泥臭い導入・運用サポートまでを地続きで捉え、自ら動いて顧客体験を最大化できる方

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. As we grow with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, their architecture questions get harder: How does Taktile fit into an existing, complex and some-times decades-old core banking system landscape? How do we design for their security, availability, compliance, and integration requirements? Who speaks the language of their enterprise architects?
That's this role. As Solution Architect, you are a senior technical voice in our customer conversations - a sparring partner to enterprise architects at large financial institutions, helping them design how Taktile fits into their broader solution architecture.

s.h: What You'll Do as Solution Architect
s.t:
Act as the trusted architecture counterpart for enterprise architects and technical leadership on the customer side — from first pre-sales conversations through large-scale production deployments.
Design the target solution architecture for enterprise transformations: how Taktile integrates into the customer's existing landscape of core systems, data platforms, and surrounding services, and how that architecture evolves over a multi-year journey.
Own the hardest architecture questions in our deals — integration patterns, deployment models, throughput, latency, security, compliance, data residency — and turn them from blockers into reasons to buy.
Lead architecture workshops, whiteboarding sessions, and reference architecture reviews with customer stakeholders from engineers up to CTOs.
Represent Taktile in senior architecture discussions on the customer side, giving their enterprise architects and technical leadership a credible, expert counterpart.
Build reusable reference architectures, integration blueprints, and best practices that scale across the Forward Deployed Engineering and Sales teams.
Work across pre-sales and post-sales: supporting Account Executives and Solution Engineers on complex enterprise deals, and partnering with Forward Deployed Engineers to ensure what was sold is what gets built.

You bring 10+ years of experience in solution or enterprise architecture, with significant time spent working directly with large enterprises — ideally in financial services.
You have deep, hands-on knowledge of AWS and enterprise integration patterns (event-driven architectures, messaging, APIs, batch, streaming), and you know when to use which.
You've worked with enterprise-grade legacy systems — core banking platforms, loan origination systems (LOSs), loan management systems (LMS), front-end SDKs, mainframes, on-prem estates — and know what it actually takes to integrate a modern SaaS platform into them.
You have a solid grounding in security and compliance as they apply to regulated enterprises: authentication and authorization patterns, network architecture, encryption, data residency, and audit requirements.
You hold your own with the most senior technical stakeholders on the customer side — enterprise architects, Heads of Engineering, CTOs — and are seen as a peer, not a vendor.
You communicate complex architecture crisply, in writing, on a whiteboard, in a slide deck, and in the room, to both deeply technical and executive audiences.
You're comfortable operating across pre-sales and post-sales, and you know how to make architecture decisions that are right for the customer and commercially sound.

You have experience as a Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect, or Principal Consultant at a B2B SaaS company, cloud provider, or top-tier consultancy serving financial institutions.
You have designed architectures involving AI/ML or Generative AI workloads in production.
You hold relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Professional, TOGAF).
You have experience responding to enterprise RFPs and security/architecture reviews.

Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.
Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company.
Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.
Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

We are hiring a software architect for Canonical LXD and MicroCloud.
Our goal is to make clusters of compute, with system containers or virtual machines, "just work". It should be trivial to stand up a small cloud using one, two or twenty servers. This is a challenging exercise in distributed systems, virtualisation, container technology, networking and storage. LXD is a modern Golang system container and virtual machine orchestrator widely used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms. Lead continuous improvement initiatives across planning accuracy, demand signals, and supply execution.
Support upgrades, enhancements, and innovation initiatives aligned with business priorities and S/4HANA roadmap including but not limited to leveraging Ariba, Signavio, Joule AI, LeanIX and other SAP applications.

The Principal Security Architect is a key member of the CISO organization responsible for establishing and governing secure technology architecture across hybrid on-premises and multi-cloud environments.

This role serves as a trusted subject matter expert partnering with infrastructure, application, data, and cloud platform teams to translate security strategy, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices into practical reference architectures, security standards, and design requirements.

The Principal Security Architect leads architecture review and assurance activities to ensure solutions are implemented in alignment with approved designs and enterprise standards, and drives remediation of identified security and control gaps across identity, network segmentation, data protection, monitoring, CI/CD, and third-party integrations.
Owns enterprise security reference architectures, design standards, and security patterns across the organization. Has authority to approve, require modification of, or reject proposed designs that do not meet established security requirements, and ensures deviations are formally governed through the enterprise exception management process.

Engage in project intake and early design phases to define security requirements prior to implementation. Partner with infrastructure, application, and cloud teams to embed security-by-design into initial architecture decisions and reduce downstream rework and exception volume.
Serve as a subject matter expert for the evaluation, design, and secure adoption of infrastructure, cloud platforms, applications, and enterprise technologies, ensuring security requirements are incorporated throughout the solution lifecycle.
Lead security architecture review and assurance activities by assessing proposed and existing designs, network and application architecture diagrams, and technology implementations against enterprise standards, reference architectures, threat models, and control requirements; defining security requirements and guardrails; and validating implemented solutions align with approved designs and enterprise standards.
Identify and drive remediation of security and control gaps across identity, network segmentation, data protection, logging/monitoring, key management, CI/CD, and third-party integrations in partnership with Infrastructure, Application, Data, and Cloud Platform teams.
Design security architecture for Microsoft Fabric and lakehouse patterns (Bronze/Silver/Gold), including secure data ingestion pipelines (e.g., Data Factory), least-privilege access using service principals and managed identities, strong data governance controls such as classification, labeling, lineage, and policy enforcement via Microsoft Purview, and secure storage and access boundaries through encryption and customer-managed keys (where applicable).

Define secure ingestion and connectivity patterns for on-premises systems (e.g., EMR/Epic, relational databases) and third-party platforms (e.g., Snowflake), including segmentation, traceability, and segregation of duties between data engineering and data consumers.
Define and enforce security architecture for AI platforms and agent-based solutions (e.g., Copilot Studio, Azure AI services), including identity and access controls for service principals and managed identities, least-privilege connector design, data protection and prompt handling safeguards, logging and traceability of agent actions, and integration with enterprise data governance controls (e.g., Microsoft Purview).
Assess and integrate acquired entities into the enterprise security architecture by evaluating inherited environments, identifying control gaps, and defining transition architectures that align to enterprise standards while accounting for operational constraints.
Define and maintain Microsoft Entra ID security architecture standards, including Conditional Access, phishing-resistant MFA, PIM, RBAC design, privileged access workflows, and application identity governance.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Who We Are
Impiricus is the first and only AI-powered HCP Engagement Engine. Founded by a practicing physician and a senior pharmaceutical executive, we are redefining how life sciences companies connect with healthcare professionals (HCPs). Our platform delivers evidence-based, ethical, and high-impact omnichannel engagement that helps improve patient care through smarter communication.
With our unique access to the largest opted-in network of HCPs, their insights, and clinical expertise, we are the leading provider of AI technology and real-time channels that life science companies need to deliver clear, reliable, and evidence-based resources directly into the hands of HCPs. Guided by a council of 2000+ trusted HCP advisors, we ensure every interaction is clinically meaningful, ethically grounded and leads to better patient care.
Ascend is our AI-enabled omnichannel engine, powering real-time, personalized engagement between HCPs and pharma partners. Job Summary We are hiring a Product Solutions Architect to be the product-led technical partner across the Ascend sales and implementation cycle. You will lead product-focused pitches, tailor and run demos in real time against a client’s specific needs, and turn client goals into a scoped, credible solution that Product and Engineering can deliver.
You are the first hire into a function we expect to grow, with the opportunity to build and lead a team as it does. Day to day, the role asks you to be comfortable across all three modes: setting strategy for how we solution, running consultative design with clients, and doing the hands-on IC work yourself.

This is not a role that delegates the build. You will sit in Product, partner daily with Commercial, Client Services, and Engineering, and carry a solution from the first discovery conversation through design, build, and deployment. Until we add Forward Deployed Engineers, the custom implementation work is yours.
We expect you to work AI-forward. We build AI products, and we expect the person selling and building them to use AI in their own craft: to go from discovery to a working prototype in days, and to bring AI-enabled capability into client solutions where it genuinely improves the HCP experience.

Pre-Sales and Product-Led Selling

Run technical discovery and qualification alongside Commercial, and lead product-focused pitches as the senior technical voice in the room.
Work hand in glove with Solutions Design across the full proposal, not only the custom portion, and own the technical narrative in RFPs and executive conversations.
Own the demo landscape across standard, brand-specific, and strategic custom environments, kept current with the roadmap so what we show matches what we ship.
Partner with Solutions Design on large or custom proposals, and with Client Services on the account roadmap.
Use AI tooling to compress the path from discovery to working prototype, so clients see something real in days rather than weeks.
Solution Architecture
Translate client goals into a scoped, credible Ascend solution and a client-level implementation roadmap.
Scope integrations, data flows, and architecture live in client conversations, with an accurate read on feasibility and effort.
Decide what is built bespoke versus pushed into the platform, so custom work compounds into product rather than debt.
Surface new features and integrations out of client conversations and bring them back sized.
Prototype during discovery, then harden the solution into a scalable, maintainable deployment.
Translate ambiguous or incomplete requirements into concrete technical specifications and working software.
Create the reusable assets and AI-assisted workflows that make solutioning repeatable rather than dependent on one person.
Collaboration and Team Leadership
Serve as the technical liaison between Commercial, clients, Product, and Engineering, keeping what we sell aligned with what we ship.
Own the technical solution end to end so Client Services can stay focused on the relationship.
Feed field reality into the roadmap so recurring client needs become standard product capability.
Define the scope and hiring bar for Forward Deployed Engineers as we add them, with the opportunity to lead that team as the function proves out.

6+ years in solutions architecture, sales engineering, solutions consulting, or forward-deployed engineering, ideally in SaaS or pharma technology.
Operates with full autonomy as the subject matter expert in the room on the most complex and strategic pursuits
Proven track record leading technical discovery and running custom demos inside enterprise pre-sales cycles, credible with senior client stakeholders.
Hands-on technical depth: able to scope feasibility, prototype, and build, not only specify.
Appetite to grow into leading and mentoring individual contributors while staying hands-on yourself.
Strong fluency with APIs, integrations, data flows, and platform configuration.
Product mindset, with clear judgment on when a client need is one-off custom work and when it should become durable platform capability.
AI-forward in how you work: fluent with AI tooling for prototyping, research, and delivery, and clear-eyed about where AI belongs in a client solution and where it does not.
Excellent communication across technical and non-technical audiences, from engineers to client executives, and comfortable operating with ambiguity at high-growth pace.
Experience in pharma commercial, market access, or HCP engagement is a strong plus, as is having helped stand up a solutions or sales engineering function.

* Rôle stratégique en architecture avec visibilité mondiale.

* Opportunité de carrière à long terme dans un secteur en croissance et innovant.

Goldschmitt & Associates is seeking an Enterprise Data/ CRM Architect to provide senior architecture leadership across Federal Student Aid's enterprise data environment, Common Data Model, customer-service platforms, integrations, analytics, and downstream data consumers.
The Enterprise Data / CRM Architect will help FSA create a coherent architecture for how borrower, loan, servicing, operational, and customer-interaction data is defined, governed, shared, and consumed across enterprise systems.
This role operates above individual pipelines or applications. The architect will define how the Common Data Model, Business Needs Layer, APIs, integration services, CRM/customer-care platforms, NSLDS, analytics environments, and other FSA systems work together while maintaining consistent data meaning, ownership, security, lineage, quality, and lifecycle controls.
The Enterprise Data/ CRM Architect must combine strong enterprise data architecture with enough application and integration knowledge to understand how data is created and used across business processes. The architect will work closely with the Senior Data Engineer, Enterprise Integration Architect, CDM Platform Engineer, Analytics Engineer, product leadership, and FSA enterprise architecture teams.
FSA's modernization requires a governed enterprise data capability that normalizes heterogeneous servicer data, improves quality and timeliness, and supports analytics, integrations, and future borrower-facing capabilities.

Lead enterprise data architecture across FSA's Common Data Model, Business Needs Layer, CRM/customer-service platforms, servicer integrations, NSLDS, analytics environments, and downstream consumers
Define the target-state architecture for how borrower, loan, servicing, customer-interaction, and operational data flows through the enterprise
Establish architecture principles for authoritative data sources, canonical data structures, shared definitions, data ownership, and system-of-record responsibilities
Define relationships between source-system models, the CDM, semantic/business layers, CRM structures, APIs, analytical models, and downstream applications
Guide development and evolution of canonical enterprise data models
Define approaches for schema versioning, compatibility, data lifecycle management, and controlled evolution of enterprise data structures
Review proposed source-to-CDM mappings and ensure transformations preserve business meaning and support enterprise reuse
Partner with the Senior Data Engineer on schema design, conformance rules, validation strategies, and complex source-data decisions
Define how customer and borrower information should be represented consistently across CRM, servicing, analytical, and digital-service environments
Identify duplicate, conflicting, or overlapping data definitions across platforms and recommend a target enterprise model
Establish patterns for data mastered in one system but consumed or enriched in another
Define architecture for data synchronization, event-driven data exchange, APIs, data products, and other enterprise access patterns
Partner with the Enterprise Integration Architect to ensure interface and integration patterns support the enterprise data model
Establish requirements for data contracts between producers and consumers
Define architecture standards for data quality, lineage, metadata, cataloging, stewardship, and governance
Ensure architecture supports traceability from source through transformation to downstream consumption
Define appropriate controls for sensitive borrower and financial information, including access, security, privacy, auditability, and least-privilege use
Evaluate the architecture impacts of read-only near-real-time servicer integration and future bi-directional exchange
Assess the impact of proposed UBP and customer-service capabilities on enterprise data structures and data services without defining out-of-scope UBP features
Identify technical debt, redundant data movement, tightly coupled integrations, and other architecture patterns that limit reuse or product agility
Develop architecture decision records, reference architectures, data-flow diagrams, data lifecycle plans, interface patterns, and phased modernization roadmaps
Evaluate alternative architectures and clearly document tradeoffs involving cost, complexity, scalability, reliability, security, data quality, and maintainability
Support architecture reviews and provide independent technical recommendations to FSA leadership
Work with product leaders to ensure data architecture decisions support measurable business and borrower outcomes
Work with analytics and HCD teams to ensure enterprise data structures are understandable and useful to business consumers
Help establish an architecture that allows FSA to evolve data products and services without repeatedly rebuilding point-to-point transformations
Mentor engineers and architects on enterprise data architecture practices and promote consistent standards across teams and contractors

Significant experience designing enterprise data architectures across multiple applications and organizational domains

About DuploCloud
DuploCloud is an Agentic Internal Developer Platform (IDP) for DevOps and platform engineering teams. With DuploCloud , teams can automate any complex DevOps use case as an AI agent and deploy it to their entire organization in a matter of hours to days, instead of the months it has traditionally taken.

Ephemeral environments, release management, deployment automation, Kubernetes upgrades, incident triage, security patching, compliance remediation, Terraform drift detection and remediation: each becomes a governed, multi-user agent that runs inside the customer's own cloud.
Our premise is the 70/30 problem: every DevOps workflow is bespoke, but roughly 70% of what it does is the same set of functions over and over (kubectl access, tailing logs, deploying a microservice, triggering pipelines, observability, compliance reports, cost dashboards, Terraform modules), while the remaining ~30% is the logic specific to that organization.

DuploCloud delivers the common core as a shared platform and lets teams build only their custom delta as Agents on top.

The product has two components: the Agent Platform, powered by ARMOR (Agent Runtime for Multiplayer Operations), which provides shared multiplayer AI sessions, workspaces, SSO and RBAC, secrets management, audit trails, human-in-the-loop approvals, token cost controls and a Model Router for per-workflow LLM choice across Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and open-source models; and the Coding Assistant, a Claude Code plugin paired with our DevKit that lets a platform engineer describe a use case in plain English, build and test the resulting Agent against a local copy of the platform on their laptop, and publish it to their organization.

Agents ship with rich UX (forms, wizards, dashboards, status views) and are invocable from the Web UI, API, CLI, MCP, Terraform provider, and Slack/Teams. Routine, high-frequency actions run token-less as pre-coded scripts, reserving the LLM for judgment.
The platform runs fully self-hosted in the customer's cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP, onprem) or DuploCloud -managed, supports SOC 2, HIPAA and PCI compliance requirements, and is used by engineering organizations from high-growth startups to the enterprise. Headquartered in San Jose, DuploCloud is a venture backed company, Series-B funded by WestBridge Capital and StepStone Group.

DuploCloud is looking for a Solutions Architect with a demonstrated background in cloud technologies, DevOps and platform engineering, and AI-driven automation, who drives customer success through solution architecture.

This is a customer-facing technical pre-sales role: you will work hand-in-hand with the Sales organization from the first technical conversation with a prospect through a successful proof of concept, deal conversion, and hand-off to our Onboarding and Forward Deployed Engineering teams.

The heart of the role is understanding how a prospect actually runs operations today and then showing them, concretely and in their own terms, how DuploCloud solves their pain points.

Lead technical discovery conversations with prospects' DevOps, platform engineering, SRE and engineering leadership to deeply understand their current ops workflows: how they provision environments, ship releases, manage Terraform and Kubernetes, respond to incidents, and enforce security and compliance, and where the toil, bottlenecks and risk live.
Map the prospect's workflows onto DuploCloud 's 70/30 model: identify which parts are already covered by the platform's built-in capabilities and Agent library, and isolate the custom, organization-specific piece that needs to be built.
Design and build a custom agent tailored to the prospect's specific use case, using the DuploCloud Coding Assistant and DevKit to define the policy model, write skills and generate the workflow UX, so the prospect can see their own ops workflow running as a governed, multi-user agent and fully understand how DuploCloud solves their pain points.
Deliver compelling live demos and scoped proofs of concept (PoC/PoV), on a laptop or in the prospect's cloud, that prove value on a real workflow and create a clear path to a technical win.
Perform detailed infrastructure assessments of prospects' existing environments and produce cost calculators, business ROI plans, and migration and implementation project plans.
Own technical objection handling, architecture and security reviews, and build-vs-buy conversations with both technical audiences and executives.
Partner closely with the Onboarding and Forward Deployed Engineering teams for a successful hand-off, carrying forward the context and custom agents designed during the pre-sales cycle.
Feed field learnings back to Product and Engineering, and contribute reusable Agents, skills and demo assets to our Agent library.

5+ years of demonstrated experience as a solutions architect, cloud architect, DevOps/platform engineer, or SRE, including time spent working with both customers and internal teams in a pre-sales, consulting, or delivery capacity.
Strong hands-on knowledge of public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP); on-prem infrastructure experience is a plus.
Strong knowledge of Kubernetes, ECS and similar container orchestration technologies.
Strong knowledge of Terraform and similar IaC technologies, and of CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Argo CD).
Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, or similar), and a working understanding of MCP, skills/prompt design, and LLM trade-offs such as model selection, token cost, and human-in-the-loop controls. You will use these daily to build custom Agents for prospects.
Proven ability to run technical discovery: ask the right questions to map a prospect's ops workflow end to end, identify where the toil and risk live, and translate that into a scoped, demonstrable solution.
Problem solver who can interpret sophisticated problem statements, boil them down into simple solutions, and collaborate with prospects and channel partners.
Strong presenter and demo storyteller, equally comfortable in a business and technical context, whether working with executives or talking shop with technical audiences.
Able to produce clear written artifacts: solution architectures, PoC plans, cost calculators, ROI models, and migration/implementation plans.
Working understanding of security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI) as they apply to cloud infrastructure and AI-driven automation.
Scripting or programming proficiency (e.g., Python, Bash, Go) sufficient to build and debug Agents, skills, and integrations.
Dynamic team member who will both teach and learn from all of us on the Solutions Engineering team; open to giving and receiving feedback, tolerant of failure, and passionate about making clients successful.
Enjoy helping customers through their infrastructure and AI transformation, from the first discovery call through a successful PoC and hand-off to onboarding.
Experience with platform engineering / IDP tooling (e.g., Backstage), observability stacks, or early-stage startup environments.

Alkira, a Lumen company, is building the future of enterprise networking: one programmable platform to connect, secure, and operate every cloud, site, partner, data center, and AI workload.
Founded by Amir and Atif Khan, the creators of Viptela and pioneers of the SD-WAN market, Alkira was built to radically simplify how enterprises deploy and manage network infrastructure. Today, as part of Lumen, we are bringing that cloud-native operating model to a global network foundation trusted by the world’s largest enterprises.
Our platform helps customers move faster without managing hardware, stitching together providers, or operating fragmented cloud networks. Teams can build and scale connectivity on demand, apply consistent security and segmentation, and gain visibility across distributed environments from one place.
At Alkira, you’ll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud-like consumption, private-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build technology that changes how global businesses connect.
Join us and help build the future of networking.

Nemours Children’s Health is seeking a Laboratory Informatics & Technology Architect, Full-Time Remote, to join our team.
Must reside in one the following states to be considered: Alabama, Colorado, Delaware, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas or Virginia.
This position will be responsible for leading the strategy, design, and delivery of technology solutions that support the future of laboratory medicine, with a strong focus on digital pathology. Qualified applicants will be experienced laboratory informatics or healthcare IT professionals with knowledge of anatomic pathology workflows, digital imaging, laboratory information systems, electronic medical records, and clinical and research laboratory operations.
The architect position will shape the roadmap for laboratory applications, digital pathology platforms, and instrument and system integrations. They will partner with pathologists, laboratory leaders, operational teams, vendors, and Information Systems teams to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, reliable, interoperable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
As a technical leader and trusted advisor, the Architect will guide digital pathology initiatives, laboratory application implementations, production issue resolution, and long-term system planning while serving as a vendor contact, stakeholder partner, and mentor to team members.
Essential Functions
Support digital pathology implementation planning, including current-state workflow assessment, future-state design, stakeholder readiness, validation and testing strategy, go-live preparation, and post-live optimization.
Partner with pathology, laboratory operations, vendors, and Information Systems teams to support whole slide imaging, image management, scanner connectivity, storage planning, interoperability, and integrations with laboratory and electronic medical record systems.
Develop technology strategies and roadmaps for medical and research laboratory applications, digital pathology platforms, and electronic medical record solutions that support organizational goals.
Lead enterprise architecture design, development, and maintenance for laboratory applications, technology platforms, and electronic medical record information systems.
Assumes a significant role in establishing and maintaining technology governance processes such as an Architecture Review Board and/or Data Governance Committee.
Research, evaluate, and select appropriate technology solutions; develop technical content for RFI/RFP processes; lead evaluations; and assist with budget estimates for selected solutions.
Provide strategic guidance for laboratory application implementations, daily support needs, vendor coordination, stakeholder engagement, and end-user adoption.
Leads root cause, troubleshooting, or problem resolution teams to resolve chronic production problems. Presents findings, recommendations, and specifications in formal reports and/or oral presentations to the Supervisor, Project Manager, and/or Peers.
Review solution objectives and constraints, confirm alignment with enterprise architecture, and identify implementation risks, dependencies, and operational impacts.

Master’s degree required. Equivalent work experience may be considered for internal candidates only in lieu of education requirements.
Minimum of five or more years of information technology experience working in large-scale, heterogeneous IT environments required.
CIIP Certification required or must be obtained within 12 months of hire.

Experience with digital pathology, anatomic pathology workflows, imaging platforms and laboratory information systems.

Our SAP platform is at a pivotal moment; moving to RISE, migrating to s/4, embracing Clean Core, and building the BTP foundations that will power our next decade of innovation. The Platform Architect is the person who connects all these dots: architecture, extensibility, developer enablement, and governance.

If you want to shape a global SAP landscape across a portfolio of iconic luxury Maisons, this is the role. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?Within the SAP platform team, the SAP Platform Architect defines and governs the SAP platform architecture across S/4HANA (ERP, EWM, GTS-), SAP BTP, and all integration touchpoints.

Shaping the technology landscape, setting guardrails, and ensuring every extension or customisation is justified, sustainable, and future-proof.

You will lead the OSBF Design Authority, promote Clean Core principles and SAP-s extensibility strategy (side-by-side vs. in-app), and ensure alignment with both SAP-s product roadmap and our enterprise architecture. Your impact spans across a multi-stream technical roadmap covering 4 strategic pillars: 1.

Architecture Vision & Roadmap Own and drive the architectural direction of the platform across Core Architecture, BTP & Development.

Participate in strategic architectural decisions such as use cases for BTP, Federated platforms (Mendix, Tulip, Pega-), ERP/EWM decoupling, S/4HANA continuous evolution, including associated topics such as Job Scheduling or establishing a Printing Platform for the group.

Collaborate with the Enterprise Architecture team on cross-cutting concerns such as Disaster Recovery design and enterprise-wide technology alignment. Evolve the Platform to further integrate CI/CD practices. Integrate Richemont AI strategy in the platform roadmap & design.

Define consumable and reusable services for product teams that accelerate delivery, increase product teams- autonomy, and reduce the need for custom development, duplicated effort, and reliance on central platform expertise. 2.

Clean Core Governance & Extensibility Strategy Define and enforce Clean Core guidelines: minimise custom code, maximise standard, and leverage key-user extensibility and BTP side-by-side extensions.

Own the decision framework for -where to extend-: in-app (BAdIs, RAP, key-user extensibility) vs. side-by-side (CAP on BTP, Integration Suite, or Federated Platforms). Guide product teams on the right extensibility pattern for each use case. Conduct architecture reviews for all significant developments. 3.

Standards, Patterns & Guardrails Integrates Group Standards for reusable architecture patterns, in particular for API design and ownership, event-driven integration, data models, CDS views, and Fiori apps.

Champion configuration as Code for sap platforms, including BTP (Terraform) which adheres to Richemont guidelines in terms of security, Identity management and connectivity. Publish and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and reference architectures.

Guide the technical archiving and data volume management strategy and application retirement (ILM). Provide architectural direction on data lifecycle decisions that impact platform performance, storage costs, and compliance. 4. Community & Enablement Participate in cross-team design reviews and lead the SAP platform Architecture Board.

Establish and animate an Architect Community across the product teams. Stay ahead of SAP technology evolution through continuous learning, SAP community engagement, and vendor dialogue. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

Education & Experience 10+ years of progressive experience in SAP ecosystems, with deep expertise across S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and hybrid integration landscapes. 3+ years in an SAP platform architecture role. Master-s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Technical Expertise SAP S/4HANA: Deep understanding of S/4HANA architecture, Clean Core methodology, custom code analysis (ATC, Custom Code Migration app), and extensibility options (BAdIs, RAP, key-user extensibility).

SAP BTP: Strong knowledge of the BTP service portfolio - CAP, Integration Suite, SAP Build Work Zone, HANA Cloud, AI Core / Generative AI Hub, Event Mesh, Destination & Connectivity services. Architecture Patterns: Proven expertise in API-first design, event-driven architecture, side-by-side extensions, and Fiori/UX architecture.

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, configuration as code - Terraform Security Awareness: Solid understanding of SAML 2.0, OIDC, SSO, and identity management concepts RISE: Understanding of the RISE with SAP operating model and SAP Cloud ALM.

Soft Skills & Behaviours Visionary yet pragmatic: Balances long-term architecture ambition with short-term delivery reality (strategic vs. tactical). Strong conviction with open mind: Defends architectural principles but listens to field constraints.

Excellent communicator: Explains complex architecture concepts to business stakeholders, product teams, and technical audiences alike. Collaborative authority: Influences without commanding; earns trust through expertise. Works with security, operations, and enterprise architecture - not in place of them.

Systems thinking: Sees the whole SAP landscape as interconnected and integrated within a global, heterogeneous enterprise landscape. Never forgets the Enterprise Architecture guiding principles. Intellectual curiosity: Continuously tracks SAP innovation and industry best practices.

Deine Mission
Du arbeitest in interdisziplinären Projektteams und unterstützt unsere Kund:innen dabei, die Implementierung von Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & SCM zur Erfolgsstory zu machen. Unsere Projekte sind vielfältig und betreffen Kund:innen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen.

Du arbeitest mit Projektteams und Expert:innen aus verschiedenen Bereichen zusammen, um End to End Prozesse zu definieren und Dienstleistungen auf Basis fundierter technischer und fachlicher Expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 bereitzustellen.
Mithilfe etablierter Methoden sorgst Du für eine transparente Darstellung von Prozessen, Aufgaben und Strukturen im gesamten Projekt. Du bleibst am Puls der Zeit, indem Du dich kontinuierlich weiterbildest, neue Projekte umsetzt und in einem internationalen Umfeld mit vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten arbeitest. Ziel ist es, nachhaltige Lösungen zu schaffen und die ERP-Implementierung sowohl effektiv als auch effizient zu gestalten.

Strategisches Lösungsdesign
Definition und Implementierung integrierter ERP‑Lösungen mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & SCM, einschließlich der Gestaltung und Integration auf globale Geschäftsanforderungen zugeschnittener ERP‑Systeme sowie der Sicherstellung, dass Kundenbedürfnisse in umsetzbare, wirkungsvolle Dynamics‑365‑ERP‑Lösungen übersetzt werden.

Dazu gehören die Analyse komplexer Schnittstellenanforderungen, die Anwendung moderner Architekturkonzepte und die Erstellung von Lösungsdesign‑Dokumenten für geschäftskritische Prozesse. Deine Expertise in neuesten Technologien und Trends gewährleistet die Entwicklung innovativer und effektiver ERP‑Landschaften.
Projektleitung & Performance
Festlegung und Überwachung von Projektmeilensteinen zur Sicherstellung einer reibungslosen Teamabstimmung sowie Definition von Kennzahlen zur Bewertung der ERP‑Systemleistung und des Projekterfolgs über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus.

Als zentrale Ansprechperson unterstützt du Projektteams bei bereichsübergreifenden funktionalen Anforderungen und begleitest die Implementierung von Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & SCM, um sicherzustellen, dass sämtliche Projektaspekte höchsten Qualitätsstandards entsprechen.
Kundenentwicklung & Beziehungsmanagement
Vorbereitung und Begleitung von Kund:innen bei der Einführung von ERP‑Lösungen sowie aktive Pflege der Kundenbeziehungen. Die Rolle umfasst die Beratung der Kund:innen, die enge Zusammenarbeit in agilen Projektteams sowie kontinuierliches Lernen und Wissensaustausch innerhalb des Business‑Bereichs. Darüber hinaus stellst du sicher, dass Kund:innen befähigt werden, ERP‑Systeme effektiv für ihre spezifischen Geschäftsanforderungen einzusetzen.

The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with retail and consumer businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption.

The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.

As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of Retail customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.

Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
Apply Retail expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.
